There are plenty of other dating apps for men. Literally every other dating app other than this one, so why can’t we have one app just for women looking for women?

reviews.title: Disappointing Support Experience
reviews.text: I actually like using this app since we don’t have to pay for everything. Unfortunately I am upset with my experience with the support system. First, my account gets put on hold for network connection issue and flagged for suspicious activity and I was made to send my ID or photo. Verified myself through ID. Then I find out that my account won’t get reinstated and terminated if I make a new one. I didn’t receive the best emails that wouldn’t tell me why due to “privacy” policies and I got a wail acting as if I was asking for other accounts, but I was asking for mine. It felt like AI automated responses then a human being. I believe there was a misunderstanding with my ban but I am unsure how to appeal that and was given no option to. I would like to use this app because I enjoy it, but it does make me sad and I’m willing to fix what I did if I know what exactly the problem was. I would just like to have one more option. Come back to edit my review. Don’t bother to use this app and please take a look at ALL reviews including negative ones. HER has a raising issue of banning accounts with no option to appeal and won’t state the reason. So far, I haven’t seen them respond to one and offering a solution. Be careful with HER!

reviews.title: Accounts on hold

You have numerous fake accounts, people trying to do threesome and men on this app, but want to suspend my account for no reason. You should be ashamed to even consider yourself a good app because it shouldn’t take you 14+ days to respond to my ticket. I hope you do better with this app instead of suspending actual real people who are trying to find other people to connect with.

reviews.title: horrible customer service
reviews.text:

I reached out to costumer services intending to dispute this issue. Customer support then informed me that “Due to our privacy practices, we cannot disclose specifics about any member account, including your own. Any new accounts created will be subject to review and will be immediately terminated.” 
I had only just downloaded the app and did nothing to violate and rules on the app.

My account was been banned despite verifying my identity TWICE. Originally they said it was the VPN being detected, but after going through verification AGAIN, they’ve banned me from the app and refuse to share what terms I’ve violated. Keep in mind I haven’t even had the opportunity to message anyone. Super disappointing. Won’t be recommending this to anyone i know.

reviews.title: Unhelpful customer service
reviews.text: I really liked the app at first but then, after literally 2 hours of being on there, my account was banned. There was no reason as to why apart from that someone reported it, yet I 100% didn’t violate any community guidelines, I didn’t even send any messages yet. Really awful, unhelpful customer service, was told that they reviewed it and banned me but with no reason as to why or why I can’t make a new account. Do not recommend at all.

reviews.title: Banned immediately
reviews.text: I downloaded the app, created a profile and was immediately banned. I tried to see what happened and they would not tell me. They talked about their community guidelines which I read through and I don’t think I broke any of them. I didn’t even get the chance to see anyone else’s profile. Contacting support was not helpful as I tried asking what happened and they just said I was banned and they would no longer reply to my messages. They didn’t even ask me to verify my pictures. Not sure what happened but definitely disheartening. Just trying to explore and figure myself out.

reviews.title: Banned for NO reason (no guidelines broken)

I literally got banned for no reason (I was on there for like a day - literally said hi to one person and that was it). I was not discriminatory, harassing, inappropriate, or anything. The only thing I could possibly think of was someone didn’t like my pole photo (which I was fully clothed in, btw). I tried to appeal, but got no explanation and the support team did honor the appeal or even inquire about it. HORRIBLE customer service team, and there is no phone number.

reviews.title: account banned immediately with no explanation
reviews.text: i made my first ever account/profile last night and when i went to log in this afternoon i got an error message saying my account was on hold. i contacted support and got an email saying to send a photo of my driver’s license to verify my identity. i replied with said photo and immediately got another emailing stating that my profile was reported by members of the community for breaking the community guidelines. my account didn’t even exist for 24 hours, my profile was still a work in progress, and i didn’t even have the chance to interact with anyone on the app. now they’re refusing to provide me with any information about the specific guidelines i apparently violated. instead, they stated that the appeal has been reviewed and the decision is final. it’s obvious that whatever AI tool they have in their system to flag accounts needs to be removed, as numerous people on reddit have reported this as a common issue. it’s really unacceptable that the her app is actively excluding lgbtq+ community members from their app without providing any justification. do better.

reviews.title: banned without verification. discrimination against users.
reviews.text:
I was permanently banned from this app after another user falsely reported my profile, despite me clearly following all community guidelines.

There’s no human review or due process whatsoever after a profile is reported. Rather than verifying whether the report had any actual basis, the platform immediately banned this and any other accounts I make in the future based solely on an unverified user flag.

This policy enables bad actors to use false reports as a tool for harassment and discrimination. Anyone can weaponize the reporting feature, knowing the app will blindly ban the reported user without looking into the situation.

Save your time and money, if someone decides to report your account out of prejudice or spite, you can lose your entire profile instantly with zero support or human intervention to fix it.

reviews.title: Zero Transparency, Zero Accountability
reviews.text:
Extremely Disappointing Experience With Support and Account Termination

I would not recommend this app based on my experience.

My account was terminated for allegedly violating community guidelines, but I genuinely do not understand what I supposedly did wrong. All of the photos on my profile were my own, and the only reason I had recently updated them was because I dyed my hair. I had spoken to approximately four people, and my conversations consisted of ordinary questions about how they were doing and what they were up to.

I reviewed the community guidelines and could not identify anything I had done to violate them. When I contacted support to ask for clarification, I was told they could not tell me what I had done because of privacy concerns. This was especially frustrating because the alleged violation concerned my own account, yet I was given no meaningful explanation.

What is the point of having community guidelines if users can be removed for allegedly violating them without being told what they did wrong? How are users supposed to understand or address an issue when they aren’t given enough information to do so?

I understand that platforms need rules and that those rules should be enforced. However, I also believe users deserve transparency, fair treatment, and a reasonable opportunity to understand a decision that results in losing access to their account.

I joined HER hoping to meet people and make connections. Instead, I was left feeling frustrated, confused

reviews.title: Mystery termination
reviews.text: I created an account a few days ago, was verified the next day, and then later that day was locked out and received an automated message that my account was flagged as suspicious and that I needed to provide additional verification. I sent the additional information and then this morning received another automated message that my account was reported for breaking community guidelines and that they won’t be reinstating my account. I sent another message asking for specifics and was told that would violate their privacy practices. I had done nothing but write a basic bio and upload my very boring photos. I sent no messages, though I had one pending when I was blocked - sorry Ally! I’m a middle-aged Buddhist librarian. I’ve never been banned (or even warned) on any platform in my long life. Was it an error? Is this just bad AI? Is it because I’m trans? Hard to say - I guess it’s good I hadn’t given them any money.

reviews.title: Too Many Scammers and Poor Profile Screening
reviews.text:
I’ve been using this app for a while, and unfortunately, my experience has been very disappointing. There are far too many suspicious profiles and scammers, including profiles that are supposedly “verified.” One of the biggest red flags is how often people immediately ask you to move the conversation to Telegram, Signal, or another external messaging app. I honestly don’t understand the need for that when our phones already have messaging apps and this platform already provides a way to communicate.

I have met a few genuine people, so I know there are real users here, but they seem to be buried among the fake and questionable profiles.

And this is supposed to be a lesbian dating app, yet I have come across men on the platform as well. That makes absolutely no sense and raises serious questions about how profiles are being screened and whether the app is actually enforcing its own purpose.

The potential is there, but the number of questionable profiles, people trying to move conversations off-platform, and men appearing on a lesbian dating app seriously hurt the experience. The app needs much stronger verification, better moderation, and a more effective system for removing scammers and inappropriate profiles. Right now, I simply cannot recommend it.

reviews.title: Absolutely ridiculous app, please do not waste your time
reviews.text:
While I was scrolling through Tinder, I got a sudden notification to make a HER account. This notification allowed me to import all of my photos from my Tinder profile. So I made the account, and added all of my extra information. I get to the homepage and I get the common apple pop-ups such as enabling notifications, I select no. Then both pop ups for app asks you for tracking permission and location appear at the same time. I click “Ask app not to track” for the info and all of a sudden I am told that my account is suspended. I have no clue why.

I reached out to support and submitted a photo of me, holding up today’s date to prove that I am a person. So my account gets enabled and once I get back into my account, I find that my photos from Tinder are GONE and I have to start over as if I never made the account. Again, I get the two pop-ups at the same time , and I click “ask app not to track” and I get locked out of my account again. 

Personally, I come from a cybersecurity background, and I have no clue as to why this is happening. I am on my home Wi-Fi and I do not use a VPN. In addition, I am on a genuine, unmodified device. But is what most concerning is the fact that I probably have to enable tracking on a dating app. I never had to do this on other dating apps.

In the end, I’ve never dealt with such a headache of a dating app before. Please do not waste your time making an account as you will end up being completely frustrated.

I’d honestly give it no stars if I could, and I’ve had the app for a week at most.

Don’t even get me started on the premium feature. This entire app is a cash grab and I’m not convinced it would be even slightly better if I used the paid version. It’s near impossible to make a match with what you’re looking for, especially because searching by category is a premium feature too, and by the time you do match it’s been far too long. Horrifically overpriced that realistically no one in this economy can afford, and even if they could, why would they give their hard earned money to a bunch of money desperate developers. 

Honestly, it’s an embarrassing excuse for a dating app, and I wouldn’t waste your time with it.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text:
I finally gave online dating a real try after months of debating it, paid for the features, and genuinely approached it with an open mind. Unfortunately, the experience felt more hollow than hopeful.

The same profiles cycle repeatedly, creating the illusion of choice rather than offering real connection. Swiping becomes less about discovery and more about superficial judgement based on curated poses, gym selfies, rock-climbing shots, or standing beside a horse as if lifestyle props substitute for personality.

The platform encourages instant visual assessment instead of meaningful interaction, which makes the process feel performative and transactional rather than human. For anyone seeking depth, emotional maturity, or genuine compatibility, this environment feels mismatched at best.

I don’t regret trying. Curiosity deserves closure. But this app didn’t reflect the kind of connection I’m looking for, so I’ll be letting my subscription expire and moving on.

Not a failure of effort, just a mismatch of intention.

reviews.title: Banned without warning
reviews.text:
This has been my go to app since it was first released back in ~2013. Never had any issues with it (aside from successfully finding a long term relationship lol). Have even been a paying subscriber on and off many times. Woke up today and without warning my verified account was banned. I requested an appeal and they denied it without any explanation. I even requested they go through my messages to see that I am a real and genuine person. I strongly believe an ex who was feeling vengeful falsely reported me to prevent me from moving on. I am also a masc lesbian and have seen all the reviews of other masc women / non binary / trans people being banned without reason so I guess it could be that, too. Horrible customer service experience!

Also, beware: there are a lot of obvious bots, they’ve changed the paywall so you can only see a few matches at a time, they’ll tell you that you have more new matches than you actually do, app is basically useless unless you pay (which I would be wary of after seeing people have been banned right after paying and not refunded), lots of men and couples, etc.
